findings.claim: Lines 29 and 35-36 let the Engineer 'consertar' the two *-fresh-local-stack.sql files, but lines 41-42 waive rerunning the scratch spec. If the Engineer changes even one byte, the only C-02-01 proof becomes the maestro's historical 3/3 run (TASK-0006-maestro-adenda.md:11-12), which measured different bytes. The ratification would then close C-02-01 with no measurement of the delivered file. That loosens the C-02-01 gate (CTG-0002.md:23: seed.sh twice, both exit 0, plus integrity queries).
findings.fix: State conditionally: (a) if no SQL changes, ratify statically and report the SHA-256 of both SQL files, matching the bytes the adenda measured; (b) if any SQL changes, either rerun in scratch the same command as adenda:11 (disposable PostGIS container, dedicated scratch DB, never the persistent stack, teardown reported) or report C-02-01 as pending/BLOCKED. Do not ratify an unmeasured change.

findings.claim: The prompt names a trigger on 'rait_required_signer', but the real table is inf.rait_minutes_required_signer (ddl/36-inf-rait-session.sql:458-460). The prompt also does not say that the rait_minutes trigger is column-scoped (before update of id, tenant_id, session_id, content, generated_at, document_hash or delete, line 435), and that scope is exactly the 'regra exata' the Engineer must report. With the wrong name, the DDL review may be incomplete.
findings.fix: Fix the name to inf.rait_minutes_required_signer. Point to ddl/36-inf-rait-session.sql:421-470 as the full set of immutable tables (rait_vote, rait_minutes, snapshot, manifest, required_signer, signature_receipt).

findings.claim: The adenda abbreviates the URLs as '.../postgres' and '.../detran_r7_ctg1_a2_seed_profiles'. Without host and port, nobody can independently confirm that the scratch ran against the disposable container detran-r17-task0006-verify (line 13) and not the persistent stack DB. The prompt tells the Engineer to accept this proof as historical (ratify.md:42).
findings.fix: Before dispatch, the maestro adds the host:port of the disposable container to the adenda (as an addendum, with no secrets). Alternatively, the prompt requires the Engineer to record that the scratch isolation was not checked independently.

findings.claim: The report template has no field for the SHA-256 of the two SQL files or for the C-02-01 status after the iteration. This makes it hard to trace which bytes the ratification under PC-3b919b021e20a792 covers.
findings.fix: Add the lines 'SHA-256 dos SQL ratificados: <40>, <60>' and 'Estado C-02-01: <provado por medicao X | pendente>'.

findings.claim: `pnpm format:check` runs 'prettier --check .' over the whole repo (package.json:16). It can fail because of files outside the Engineer's scope, and the prompt does not say what to do in that case.
findings.fix: Say that failures outside the two SQL files are reported, not fixed, or restrict the check to those two paths.

notes: Boundary respected: writes only to the two *-fresh-local-stack.sql files, which are TASK-0006's own; tests, seed.sh, DDL, contracts and other modules are explicitly forbidden (ratify.md:29-33).
Independence is well structured: the Engineer derives the policy from the DDL before reading the adenda, and reads the adenda only as provisional, non-binding evidence (ratify.md:24-27).
The PC is consistent: the file's SHA-256 3b919b02...ac3e matches compositions.json:141-142 and tasks/TASK-0006.json:24,33.

The fix under review is technically correct: 40-fixtures-rait-org-fresh-local-stack.sql:74 uses 'on conflict (id) do nothing' on inf.rait_minutes. It is the only DO NOTHING; the other upserts target mutable tables.

The prompt forbids db-reset, --full and touching the persistent DB (ratify.md:43-44). No criterion in CTG-0002 is loosened in the text; the only risk is the unmeasured-change case in the high finding.
Verdict REVIEW: one high, fixable inside the prompt; no boundary violation and no violation of a canonical source.
